name: fused_gdn_gating
description: fused_gdn_gating(A_log, a, b, dt_bias, beta=1.0, threshold=20.0) -> (g, output_gate). A_log has shape [H], a and b have shape [B, H], and dt_bias has shape [H]. With x = a.float() + dt_bias.float(), compute softplus = (1/beta) * log(1 + exp(beta*x)) when beta*x <= threshold, otherwise softplus = x. Then g = -exp(A_log.float()) * softplus and output_gate = sigmoid(b.float()). Returns newly allocated float32 tensors of shape [1, B, H]. No input mutation. All exercised inputs are float32; beta and threshold affect only g.
